narration.prompt: [low, calm] The village gave us one rule. Never go past the stone gate into the forest. At midnight, past the gate, someone started playing gamelan. [long pause] [uneasy] My friend was already walking toward it. He wouldn't answer me. He was walking in time. [long pause] [quietly] Every time my torch came back to the trees, she was there. Dancing. Slowly. A little closer. [long pause] [whispers] Her feet never touched the ground. And her arms kept reaching, further than arms should go. [long pause] [shaken] I found him at the stream. His arm was black and swollen with bites. And something was moving under his sarong. [long pause] [low, calm] The elders never blamed her. They blamed us. We broke the rule. [short pause] I still don't know if he came back.
